name: The Fruitist
note: Official sleeve-patch partner of D.C. United since 2024 (club announcement, Feb 23, 2024). Owner Agrovision Corp. renamed itself Fruitist in 2025. Founder-led, investor-backed US company; Aliment Capital led a 2024 growth investment and Blue Book Services (Apr 2025) reports the Dalio Family Office joined as a backer. No owner is named with a controlling stake, so the sponsor stays unrated.
